notes: Read all 207 source lines line by line before editing. Module docblock L1-27 ported with intent intact: the ForwardAuth session-monitor purpose, the slow /auth/session poll cadence (5 min + on focus), the SessionExpiringModal ~60s countdown / SessionExpiredModal hard-block, the 'endpoint mounted OUTSIDE /api/v1, ALWAYS returns 200 OK (internal/api/auth_session_handler.go), cannot trip the hard-401 path / infinite-redirect-loop' note, the 1Hz live-clock derivation (isExpiringSoon at <60s, hasExpired at <=0 OR authenticated===false), and the Open-mode branch (mode==='open' => isExpiringSoon/hasExpired false, both modals render nothing). Web '@module hooks/useSessionMonitor' is reframed as a native-port header; 'window focus' is annotated 'app foreground' and 'teslasync:session-expired event' as 'teslasync:session-expired signal' since native has no DOM events; '<Layout>' is annotated 'app shell'. A native-adaptation paragraph documents the only two platform substitutions.

Imports L29-32 rewired: `import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'` (L29) preserved verbatim; `import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'` (L30) preserved verbatim (the dep is in apps/native/package.json @tanstack/react-query ^5.101.1); `import { request } from '@/api/client'` (L31) -> `import { request } from '../api/client'` (the web `@/*` alias has no native tsconfig path, matching every other web-parity module; same request<T>(path, {signal}) surface); `import type { SessionInfo } from '@/api/types'` (L32) -> `import type { SessionInfo } from '../api/types'` (SessionInfo already exists in the native parity types at apps/native/src/web-parity/api/types.ts L2770 with identical shape: authenticated/mode/expires_at/expires_in/user/renewable).

Constants L34-50 ported verbatim: SESSION_POLL_MS = 5*60*1000 (L34), SESSION_STALE_MS = 4*60*1000 (L35), the L36 doc comment + SESSION_POLL_NEAR_EXPIRY_MS = 30*1000 (L37), the L38-45 docblock + NEAR_EXPIRY_THRESHOLD_S = 5*60 (L46), the L47 doc comment + exported SESSION_EXPIRING_THRESHOLD_S = 60 (L48), and the exported sessionMonitorKey = ['auth','session'] as const (L50). Names, values, units (ms / seconds), and the `as const` tuple literal are all unchanged.

SessionMonitorState interface L52-72 ported verbatim with every field and its doc comment: data (SessionInfo|null), mode ('open'|'session'|'unknown'), expiresInSeconds (number|null), isExpiringSoon, hasExpired, renewable, isLoading, and refresh: () => Promise<void>. No field was added, dropped, or retyped.

deriveSessionState() L74-149 ported verbatim — the exported pure helper so tests can exercise derivation without a QueryClient. All five return branches preserved exactly: !data => mode 'unknown' all-false (L83-91); data.mode==='open' => mode 'open' all-false (L93-101); !data.authenticated => mode 'session' hasExpired true (L103-111); the live-clock compute from RFC3339 data.expires_at via Date.parse + Number.isFinite + Math.floor((t - nowMs)/1000) (L113-122); the data.expires_in numeric fallback (L124-130); the null-expiresInSeconds => mode 'session' renewable passthrough branch (L132-140); and the final branch with isExpiringSoon = expiresInSeconds>0 && <SESSION_EXPIRING_THRESHOLD_S, hasExpired = expiresInSeconds<=0, renewable = data.renewable (L142-148). The Pick<...> return type listing mode/expiresInSeconds/isExpiringSoon/hasExpired/renewable is preserved; only prettier (arrowParens avoid, trailing-comma all, 2-space) reflowed the multi-line Pick and the isExpiringSoon expression.

useSessionMonitor() L151-207 ported with all state names, the API path, and the poll/tick logic intact. useQuery<SessionInfo> with queryKey: sessionMonitorKey and queryFn: ({ signal }) => request<SessionInfo>('/auth/session', { signal }) (L156-158) — the /auth/session path and the AbortSignal wiring are unchanged. The functional refetchInterval (L163-171) is ported verbatim — reads q.state.data, returns SESSION_POLL_MS when no data / not session-mode / unauthenticated, else SESSION_POLL_NEAR_EXPIRY_MS vs SESSION_POLL_MS gated on data.expires_in < NEAR_EXPIRY_THRESHOLD_S with Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY fallback; only the `(q) =>` param lost its parens per arrowParens:'avoid', matching the native useCharging.ts functional-refetchInterval port. staleTime: SESSION_STALE_MS (L173) and retry: 1 (L176, with its 'endpoint never 401s' comment) preserved.

refetchOnWindowFocus: true (L172) preserved verbatim. On native the QueryClient (apps/native/src/web-parity/api/queryClient.ts installNativeQueryFocusManager) wires TanStack's focusManager to React Native's AppState 'active' state, so the web 'refetch on window focus' becomes 'refetch on app foreground' — the faithful native analog, keeping the docblock's '(5 minutes, plus on app foreground)' promise. This is the same pattern the native useImpersonation.ts port keeps (refetchOnWindowFocus: true).

1Hz tick effect L179-189: [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now()) (L183) and the effect gated on query.data?.mode==='session' && query.data.authenticated with deps [query.data?.mode, query.data?.authenticated] are preserved verbatim. The ONLY platform substitution is window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000) -> setInterval(...) and window.clearInterval(id) -> clearInterval(id) (React Native globals; `id` keeps the inferred ReturnType<typeof setInterval>, matching the native useVersionWatcher.ts / globalProgress.ts ports). The derived = deriveSessionState(query.data ?? null, now) call (L191), the refresh = async () => { await query.refetch() } CTA (L193-195), and the returned object mapping data/mode/expiresInSeconds/isExpiringSoon/hasExpired/renewable/isLoading: query.isPending/refresh (L197-206) are all ported verbatim. L207-208 are the closing brace + trailing newline.

No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported — only React (useEffect/useState), @tanstack/react-query (useQuery), and the native parity api/client (request) + api/types (SessionInfo). No i18n strings or unit conversions exist in this source (it deals in unit-agnostic epoch ms / seconds), so none were introduced. Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (jest) all pass.
